implementation.compositionContract: search.bytes supplies a bounded WindowBytes value directly to the established Interpret, TryInterpret, or PartialInterpret APPLY form while the candidate path and byte coordinates remain independently projected.
implementation.failureContract: Interpret is strict; OUTER APPLY TryInterpret retains invalid candidates with null interpreted fields; PartialInterpret retains qualified nested error evidence and bytes consumed.

scenarios: TryInterpret retains false magic and invalid-length candidates while exposing the valid bounded record.
Interpret parses a complete bounded record and consumes its length-driven payload before the trailer.
PartialInterpret preserves nested over-read field, diagnostic, bytes consumed, and candidate window evidence.

gateResults.evidence: The exact Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,617 total tests, 1,583 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; the focused Search and interpretation suites also passed.

The separate review approved candidate/evidence separation, strict versus tolerant interpretation forms, nested diagnostics, evaluator compatibility and documentation; source hashes and the review artifact are retained.
Composition tests cover a valid bounded record, false magic, invalid length, strict interpretation, candidate retention and nested over-read diagnostics with independent coordinate assertions.
The versioned composition document records the established APPLY-only forms, the direct WindowBytes argument shape, strict and tolerant failure behavior, and the evaluator byte-array boundary.
The scope composes the existing bounded window without adding mutable shared state or unbounded buffering; candidate coordinates and window completeness remain available when interpretation fails.

knownLimitations: The composition passes WindowBytes directly to established interpretation APPLY forms; it does not add a new Search constructor overload.
The evaluator does not permit byte[] in a CTE or as a top-level query output column, so the verified shape retains the Search source row and uses WindowBytes as an APPLY argument.
A clipped window remains explicitly incomplete; consumers requiring the full requested range must filter on WindowComplete before interpreting.
Strict Interpret intentionally fails invalid input; consumers requiring candidate retention must use OUTER APPLY TryInterpret or PartialInterpret.
